hooks.text: 牌组、队伍连携与场景站位共同决定战术胜负
hooks.excerpt: Winning is not just a matter of playing your best hand, but also learning how to master your surroundings. Recruit new characters and assemble your party carefully: Deck synergies and team-up moves will be key to keep your tactical advantage.
